module TopModule (
    input  logic clk,
    input  logic reset,
    input  logic slowena,
    output logic [3:0] q
);

    // Synchronous reset, positive-edge-triggered flip-flops
    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 4'b0000;
        end else if (slowena) begin
            // Decade counter: count 0 -> 1 -> ... -> 9 -> 0
            if (q == 4'b1001) begin   // when q == 9
                q <= 4'b0000;         // roll over to 0
            end else begin
                q <= q + 1;           // normal increment
            end
        end
        // If slowena is low, q retains its current value (hold state)
    end

endmodule
